note: Unmodified vanilla Starsector 0.98a-RC8 graphics/debris/debris_sheet0.png. Measured 128x128 alpha sheet, sixteen separated pieces at thresholds 16 through 160; authored 4x4 cells at 32px pitch. Eight full source cells are retained as torn hull, drive and rib scenery for Asharu shipbreaking bays and fresh impact sites. Original low-resolution art is deliberately reused; footprint defines ground scale, not a recoverable hull. No existing sheet or mappings replaced.
